title: proto_sys
description: P6-04a round 2. Covers proto_sys.json (sampling, history, snapshot and DB intervals). Every key is optional because load_sys_cfg keeps defaults on a missing file or key (src/ems/main.c:1271-1340). history is undocumented in p1-03a but read as a number at src/ems/main.c:1297-1301; it is accepted here and no other unknown key is.
